items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Toodlum was a hustler. One of them big pimps. One of them big pimps, big gamblers.

ctx.x: What sort of fellow was Toodlum? Quiet, nice, fine?
Toodlum? Toodlum was a hustler. One of them big pimps. One of them big pimps, big gamblers.
See, those big old shots there.
